Title: Ship 43
Outlet: Next Spaceflight
URL: https://www.nextspaceflight.com/starship/hardware/84/

Ship 43 is a v3 Starship upper-stage. Ship 43 is expected to fly on Flight 16.

Cryogenic Proof Test #2
Cryostation, Massey Outpost, Texas, USA
Sat Oct 24, 2026
Ship 43 conducted a pair of cryogenic proof tests within the same window to verify the structural integrity of the vehicle.
